about: Roguelite track RL-14b: a run's bosses that are not a leader's Billie (battle-engine.js makeBossRobot, logic/run-loop.js runFoes). The Retrieval Unit is the Bureau's first big retrieval unit, the Voltron: four bots (a leader torso, two arm-bots, a leg-bot: boss parts in robots.json) that lock together into one robot fought as an Alpha. It is the boss of the Expeditions it names (leaders stay the boss elsewhere). Its level is the boss row's level + boss.levels; boss.hp and boss.st multiply its HP and other stats; each phase fires once when its HP falls to at of the most: a shield for shield turns, stat stages, a limb that tears loose (breaks), and its line ({name}, {part}). Its first win gives one of its parts (rewards.parts) and plays the story script story at home (only while the story's chapter is chapter). Numbers are first guesses for the sim. Intro track IN-1: the Retrieval Scout (retrieval_scout) is the prepared first run's boss (firstRun.json boss; logic/first-run.js firstRunBoss), a small Bureau bot on RL-14's parts; no Expedition names it, so it is never a later run's boss. Its look in battle is IN-3's.

retrieval.name: The Retrieval Unit

phases.say: {name} reroutes its power! A golden shield rises around it.
The {part} tears loose! {name} runs lighter and faster.

retrieval.call: The Bureau calls in {name}! It acts twice a turn. Your team steps up together.
retrieval.join: Four Bureau bots roll in... and lock together into {name}!
retrieval.win: Retrieval suspended. Claim filed as pending.

retrieval_scout.name: The Retrieval Scout

phases.say: {name} files an emergency extension! A golden shield flickers up.

retrieval_scout.call: {name} has found you. It acts twice a turn. Your team steps up together.
retrieval_scout.join: A Bureau bot rolls out of the smoke. It is holding a clipboard with your name on it.
retrieval_scout.win: Retrieval postponed. Please wait to be collected.
